coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (approximately 38%): fixed scripts/reproducibility controls, comparison of parent-to-child versus child-to-parent queries, and retrieval accuracy through top-1 accuracy.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes 150 stratified celebrity pairs for the fixed top-1000 IMDb dataset with GPT-4-verified pairs, uses a different model panel, and omits the chat-versus-completion interaction mode and temperature settings. It replaces the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests with other statistical tests and introduces fame-based hypotheses absent from the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not match the expected directional-bias conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output provides no conclusion stating that child-to-parent retrieval should outperform parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse.
